author: H. K. Moody
title: Angie Craig highlights student art contest and criticizes GOP on TSA funding
text:
U.S. Representative Angie Craig, who serves Minnesota’s 2nd district, used her social media accounts to engage with constituents and comment on recent legislative developments.
On March 22, Craig called for student participation in a national art contest, writing: “Calling all CD2 high school artists! Submit your work to the Congressional Art Competition for a chance to have your work displayed at the U.S. Capitol. Find more information at https://t.co/eua4fR9IG0. https://t.co/yuNs4AKQrk” (March 22, 2026).
The following day, she criticized congressional Republicans and former President Trump regarding funding for airport security: “Last week President Trump and House Republicans had the opportunity to fund TSA, keep Americans safe and shorten airport lines. They refused.
Remember that next time you see an hours-long TSA line.” (March 23, 2026).
Later that same morning, Craig posted a brief reaction accompanied by an emoji: ” https://t.co/ABzz713WlI” (March 23, 2026).
Craig has represented Minnesota’s 2nd District in Congress since 2019 after succeeding Jason Lewis. She was born in West Helena, Arkansas in 1972 and currently resides in Prior Lake. Craig earned her bachelor’s degree from the University of Memphis in 1994.
